title: WebSocket gateways
intro: Configure Responses gateways and review actual requests.
importHelp: Choose a local source and review its model declarations before copying.
ineligible: Not importable with the current protocol, model metadata or transport options
sourceChanged: The source configuration changed or is unavailable. Review the source before editing this independent copy.
keyHelp: This reference may be shared with the original provider. Replacing it affects new requests from every route using that reference. Save or discard configuration changes before storing a key.
discoveryFailed: Model discovery failed; configured models remain available. Check the endpoint and credential, then refresh.
headersHelp: Leave blank to retain stored headers. Enter {} to clear them. Do not store credentials here.
headersConfigured: Custom headers are stored; values are not returned to the browser
auto: Prefer WebSocket; safely fall back to SSE
continuationHelp: Requires gateway support. Rebuilds with full context after a disconnect or a history change. Smaller uploads do not guarantee lower token charges.
fallbackAfterFailures: WS failures before SSE cooling (0 disables)
retryHelp: Finite DSH retry policy. Unknown generation outcomes, authentication and quota errors are not retried automatically.
maxRequestImageBytes: Maximum total image bytes per request
deleteConfirm: Delete this standalone WS route? The original provider and conversation history are not deleted.
empty: No WS gateways configured. Import a provider or add a gateway.
readOnly: This profile cannot save gateway settings
switchConfirm: Discard unsaved changes and switch gateways?
saved: Settings saved; admitted requests retain their previous configuration
deleted: Gateway deleted; admitted requests may finish with their captured configuration
imported: Standalone WS route created; select it explicitly to use it
resetDone: Idle connections and the cooling state were reset
keySaved: API key stored; new requests use the new credential
failed: The operation failed. Review the fields and reload settings before retrying.
routeConflict: This route id already exists. Choose a different id to create a new route without overwriting it.
conflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Your draft is retained; reload before saving again.
invalidNumber: Enter a whole number within the field's supported range
resetHelp: Does not interrupt active requests. Closed connections lose their continuation state.
discoveryHelp: Refresh uses the saved gateway to read /models without generating a reply. Discovery uses the capability template below.
exclude: Exclude discovered model ids (one per line)
modelHelp: Metadata below is a local declaration, not proof of server capacity. Explicit entries override discovered metadata. Remove a row to stop explicitly advertising it.
verifyHelp: Runs two small synthetic model rounds. It can incur charges and never sends your conversation history.
verifyConfirm: Run two potentially billable model requests through this gateway? They use synthetic text only. Failed requests may also incur charges.
verified: Two WS rounds completed; incremental second request confirmed
notIncremental: Verification completed, but WS incremental continuation was not confirmed. Review policy and diagnostics.
unverified: Not yet verified by a successful request
reductionHelp: Recent retained requests only; includes retries and SSE fallback. Excludes TLS, HTTP upgrade and WS framing. Not a billing estimate.
noRequests: No requests recorded in this plugin generation
cooling: SSE cooling; refresh to update remaining time
probe: One WS recovery request is in flight
first-request: No completed response on this connection
context-changed: History is not an exact extension of the cached context
cache-miss: Gateway rejected the cached parent; full context rebuilt
candidateHelp: These are model candidates, not verified WebSocket models. Values are copied once.
importSourceChanged: The source changed. Refresh status and review its model candidates again.
importEndpointMismatch: Choose a target with the same Responses endpoint as the source.
importModelConflict: A candidate is duplicated or already on the target. Review the model list.
importSelectionInvalid: Select one or more missing models from the current preview.
importReasoningConflict: A selected model does not support the target route’s default thinking level.
routeMissing: This route no longer exists. Refresh status and select a route.
sourceProtocol: The source does not use the Responses API.
sourceEndpoint: The source needs an explicit endpoint and credential reference.
sourceTransport: The source uses a transport this gateway cannot copy.
sourceCapabilities: The source has custom capabilities this gateway cannot copy.
sourceModels: The source lists no compatible GPT model candidates.
sourceCapacity: The source model needs a valid capacity value.
sourceReasoning: The source model has custom thinking levels this gateway cannot copy.
sourceHeaders: The source has unsupported request headers.
sourceInvalid: The source cannot form a valid gateway configuration.
discoveryDisabled: Enable and save model discovery before refreshing the model list.
discoveryUnsaved: Save or discard your changes before refreshing the model list.
reasoningHelp: An explicit request level overrides the route default. If neither is set, the gateway does not send a thinking level.
reuseHint: Keep a connection for the same conversation
deltaHint: Send only new input when continuation is possible
deleteHelp: The original provider and chat history are unaffected.
mergePreserve: Existing models, credentials and transport settings remain unchanged.
requestUsageHelp: Model requests handled by this plugin instance, including auxiliary calls. Input excludes cached tokens; — means not reported. Body size is application JSON.
cleanupFailure: Some connections failed to close. Refresh and check the gateway diagnostics.
